title: AUUAOCRAFT
description: Strange devices that seem to have come from outer space...
body:
Mod with content from the video game : [AUUAO](https://darkto-kun.itch.io/auuao)

This mod introduces a species from the world of **A Universe Unlike Any Other**.
You can find their deactivated forms in structures that appear all around the world, once you find them, you can make a choice!

Depending on the choice you make, a powerful ally will manifest themselves in front of you!

**Players can summon new powerful allies that can do tasks almost like robots!, similar to the game's lore.**



_The following is a list of the powerful allies you can summon:_


- **A new mount capable of travelling long distances, jumping mid air when swinging your main hand, attacks enemy mobs on sight.**



- **A powerful mount that can mine through almost any material found in Minecraft, but you must held a pickaxe and it will consume said pickaxe durability.**


- **A magic caster that can launch a series of three fireballs in a row!
Interacting while shifting will allow to smelt certain ores, but will incinerate any sapling or food, can enchant a enchanted book.**

Fun fact : the mobs will hit each other once in a while, but do not worry!, this is just a friendly gesture, they will heal each other on impact.


The old version of this mod has been delisted as changes has made the mod way too different from the game's vision.
